curated_guidance.title: Distinguish administrative state from reachability symptoms
curated_guidance.guidance: Compare the named interface's observed administrative state and link events. Downstream probe failures establish impact, not the physical or configuration cause by themselves.

curated_guidance.title: Check the expected adjacency and underlying interface
curated_guidance.guidance: Inspect FRR neighbors and interface configuration. Point-to-point uplinks require the expected neighbor. On a broadcast network a 2-Way DROther relationship may be normal; do not label every non-Full pair a fault.

curated_guidance.title: Attribute a failed flow using rule matches and counter changes
curated_guidance.guidance: Compare the actual source, destination and incoming interface against the rule. Require a positive deny-counter change over an observation interval. Existing intended policy blocks are healthy behavior.

curated_guidance.title: Use sustained counter deltas and effective capacity
curated_guidance.guidance: Rates require elapsed time, usable consecutive counters and reset handling. Virtual NIC speed is not a validated bottleneck capacity. Inspect the configured shaping and repeat measurements before interpreting a high percentage.

curated_guidance.title: Abstain when distinguishing evidence is unavailable
curated_guidance.guidance: A lost management path can remove several signals at once. Preserve last observations and their age. Missing, stale or contradictory critical evidence requires an inconclusive outcome and further read-only checks.

review_boundary: Support is relative to the actual diagnostic input. The masked source bundle is available only to verify derived observations; it must not give credit for information absent from the diagnostic input.
